<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.WEPlusTestES6</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench: ES2021 class Script Include.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>WEPlusTestES6</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/*
 * Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench: ES2021 class Script Include.
 * In the widget's server script (check 16):
 *  - after "greeter." expect greet, count and name;
 *  - after "WEPlusTestES6." expect VERSION and create;
 *  - hover greet for its description and greet(punctuation?: string): string.
 */
class WEPlusTestES6 {
    /**
     * Creates a greeter.
     * @param {string} name - Person to greet
     */
    constructor(name) {
        /** Person to greet. */
        this.name = name;
        /** Number of greetings built. */
        this.count = 0;
    }

    /**
     * Creates a greeter for the world.
     * @returns {WEPlusTestES6} New greeter
     */
    static create() {
        return new WEPlusTestES6('world');
    }

    /**
     * Builds a greeting.
     * @param {string} [punctuation='!'] - Trailing punctuation
     * @returns {string} The greeting
     */
    greet(punctuation = '!') {
        this.count++;
        return 'Hello ' + this.name + punctuation;
    }
}

/** Library version. */
WEPlusTestES6.VERSION = '1.0';
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>44995fd572858db08ef08dac40171f21</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>WEPlusTestES6</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_44995fd572858db08ef08dac40171f21</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>wePlusTestService</name><script>function () {
    /*
     * Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench: service provider.
     * In the widget's client controller (check 19), after "wePlusTestService." expect
     * total, add and reset — not lastAdded, which is assigned inside add().
     */

    /** Running total. */
    this.total = 0;

    /**
     * Adds to the total.
     * @param {number} amount - Amount to add
     */
    this.add = function (amount) {
        this.total += amount;
        this.lastAdded = function () {
            return amount;
        };
    };

    /** Clears the total. */
    this.reset = () => {
        this.total = 0;
    };
}
</script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>72e89de7cad85f09d0c35f9d3d3d2ba2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>wePlusTestService</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_72e89de7cad85f09d0c35f9d3d3d2ba2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_updated_on><type>service</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.WEPlusTestConstants</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench: constants-only Script Include.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>WEPlusTestConstants</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/*
 * Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench: Script Include with constants only.
 * In the widget's server script, after "WEPlusTestConstants." expect STATE_APPROVED,
 * MAX_RETRIES and LABELS (check 15).
 */
var WEPlusTestConstants = Class.create();

/** State value for approved records. */
WEPlusTestConstants.STATE_APPROVED = 'approved';

/** Maximum retry attempts. */
WEPlusTestConstants.MAX_RETRIES = 3;

/** Display labels by state. */
WEPlusTestConstants.LABELS = { open: 'Open', closed: 'Closed' };

WEPlusTestConstants.prototype = {
    type: 'WEPlusTestConstants',
};
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>9156dfa33b7b270ce4bff30d441e7ca6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>WEPlusTestConstants</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_9156dfa33b7b270ce4bff30d441e7ca6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.WEPlusTestUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench: prototype Script Include.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>WEPlusTestUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/*
 * Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench: Script Include with prototype members.
 * Used by the "Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench" widget (checks 9–14).
 *
 * Checks inside this Script Include (open it in Widget Editor+):
 *  A. Inside a method, "this." lists countActive, lookup, format, describe, double, half,
 *     getFieldValue, config, defaultTable, scope and cache — not retries, timeout, onError or onDone.
 *  B. Hover "this.countActive" in describe() for its signature and description.
 *  C. After "WEPlusTestUtils." expect DEFAULT_LIMIT, FIELD_GROUPS and SEPARATOR.
 *  D. Save a change here (for example add a method), then type "utils." in the widget's
 *     server script: the new member appears without reloading the page.
 */
var WEPlusTestUtils = Class.create();

/** Default number of records to return. */
WEPlusTestUtils.DEFAULT_LIMIT = 50;

/** Field groups by table. The nested keys must not appear as members. */
WEPlusTestUtils.FIELD_GROUPS = {
    user: { primary: 'user_name', secondary: 'email' },
    task: ['number', 'short_description'],
};

/** Separator text that contains a semicolon. */
WEPlusTestUtils.SEPARATOR = 'a;b';

WEPlusTestUtils.prototype = {
    /**
     * Lookup settings. Its nested keys (retries, timeout, onError) must not appear as members.
     * @type {Object}
     */
    config: {
        retries: 3,
        timeout: 10,
        onError: function (err) {
            gs.error(err);
        },
    },

    /** @type {string} Table used when none is given. */
    defaultTable: 'incident',

    /**
     * Creates the utility.
     * @param {string} [scope='global'] - Application scope
     */
    initialize: function (scope = 'global') {
        this.scope = scope;
        this.cache = {};
    },

    /**
     * Counts active records in a table.
     * @param {string} table - Table name
     * @param {string} [field='active'] - True/false field to filter on
     * @returns {number} Number of matching records
     */
    countActive: function (table, field = 'active') {
        var ga = new GlideAggregate(table);
        ga.addQuery(field, true);
        ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
        ga.query();
        // onDone is a local callback and must not appear as a member.
        var callbacks = {
            onDone: function (count) {
                return count;
            },
        };
        return callbacks.onDone(ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT'), 10) : 0);
    },

    /**
     * Reads one field from the first matching records.
     * @param {Object} options - Lookup options
     * @param {string} options.table - Table name
     * @param {string} options.field - Field to read
     * @param {number} [options.limit] - Maximum number of records
     * @returns {string[]} Field values
     */
    lookup: function (options) {
        var values = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecord(options.table);
        gr.setLimit(options.limit || WEPlusTestUtils.DEFAULT_LIMIT);
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            values.push(gr.getValue(options.field));
        }
        return values;
    },

    /**
     * Joins values after a prefix.
     * @param {string} prefix - Text placed first
     * @param {...string} values - Values to join
     * @returns {string} Formatted text
     */
    format: function (prefix, ...values) {
        return prefix + ': ' + values.join(', ');
    },

    /**
     * Describes a record using a destructured options object.
     * @param {GlideRecord} record - Record to describe
     * @returns {string} Description
     */
    describe: function (record, { verbose = false, label = 'Record' } = {}) {
        var text = label + ' ' + record.getDisplayValue();
        return verbose ? text + ' (' + this.countActive(record.getTableName()) + ' active)' : text;
    },

    /** Doubles a number (arrow function member). */
    double: (n) => n * 2,

    /** Halves a number (shorthand method). */
    half(n) {
        return n / 2;
    },

    /**
     * Reads a field from one record.
     * @param {string} table - Table name
     * @param {string} sysId - Record sys_id
     * @param {string} field - Field name
     * @returns {string} Field value
     */
    getFieldValue: function (table, sysId, field) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
        return gr.get(sysId) ? gr.getValue(field) : '';
    },

    type: 'WEPlusTestUtils',
};
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>d8ea7a4c08719ed05f1cc7774ba45031</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>WEPlusTestUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_d8ea7a4c08719ed05f1cc7774ba45031</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_angular_provider"><sp_angular_provider action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><name>wePlusTestFactory</name><script>function ($http) {
    /*
     * Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench: factory provider.
     * In the widget's client controller (check 18), after "wePlusTestFactory." expect
     * load, save and pageSize; hover load for its description and parameters.
     */

    /**
     * Loads records from a table.
     * @param {string} table - Table name
     * @param {Object} [params={}] - Extra query parameters
     * @returns {Promise<Object>} Response promise
     */
    function load(table, params = {}) {
        return $http.get('/api/now/table/' + table, { params: params });
    }

    /**
     * Updates a record.
     * @param {string} table - Table name
     * @param {Object} record - Record values, including sys_id
     * @returns {Promise<Object>} Response promise
     */
    var save = function (table, record) {
        return $http.patch('/api/now/table/' + table + '/' + record.sys_id, record);
    };

    return { load, save: save, pageSize: 20 };
}
</script><sys_class_name>sp_angular_provider</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>b04204701288ecd5d4f061f5db81a58b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>wePlusTestFactory</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_angular_provider_b04204701288ecd5d4f061f5db81a58b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_updated_on><type>factory</type></sp_angular_provider></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_widget"><sp_widget action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><client_script>api.controller = function ($scope, wePlusTestFactory, wePlusTestService) {
    /*
     * Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench (client controller).
     */
    var c = this;

    // 18. Factory provider: "wePlusTestFactory." lists load, save and pageSize;
    //     hover load for load(table: string, params?: object) and its description.
    c.loading = true;
    wePlusTestFactory.load('incident', { sysparm_limit: 1 }).then(function () {
        c.loading = false;
    });

    // 19. Service provider: "wePlusTestService." lists total, add and reset — not lastAdded.
    wePlusTestService.add(2);
    c.total = wePlusTestService.total;

    // 20. Server and client APIs: click between this pane and the server script;
    //     here "spUtil." completes, and in the server script "gs." completes.

    // 23. Server response data: c.server.get returns the server script's new data, so reading
    //     resp.data.refreshedTotal counts as using data.refreshedTotal (no "never used" hint there).
    c.server.get({ action: 'refreshTotal' }).then((resp) => {
        c.refreshedTotal = resp.data.refreshedTotal;
    });
};
</client_script><controller_as>c</controller_as><css>/* 23. SCSS: type "$" for variables from monaco.plus.scss.variables, and "var(--" for CSS variables. */
.we-plus-test {
  pre {
    max-height: 20rem;
    overflow: auto;
  }
}
</css><data_table>sp_instance</data_table><demo_data/><description>Numbered checks for Widget Editor+ IntelliSense. Open it in Widget Editor+ and follow the comments.</description><docs/><field_list/><has_preview>true</has_preview><id>we-plus-intellisense-test</id><internal>false</internal><link/><name>Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench</name><option_schema/><public>false</public><roles/><script>(function () {
    /*
     * Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench (server script).
     * Each numbered check says where to place the cursor and what to expect.
     * Press Ctrl+Space for suggestions and hover with the mouse for documentation.
     */

    // 1. Field completion: type "gr." on a new line below this one; expect incident fields such as caller_id.
    var gr = new GlideRecord('incident');
    gr.addQuery('active', true);

    // 2. Field-name strings: clear the first argument below and press Ctrl+Space for incident fields;
    //    type "caller_id." to dot-walk into sys_user fields.
    gr.addQuery('caller_id.department', '!=', '');
    gr.query();

    // 3. Field hover: hover "department" in the string above for its label, type and referenced table.

    // 4. GlideAggregate: "ga." lists problem fields; the second argument of addAggregate suggests fields.
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('problem');
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT', 'priority');
    ga.groupBy('state');

    // 5. Query conditions: the first argument of addOrCondition suggests incident fields.
    var qc = gr.addQuery('priority', 1);
    qc.addOrCondition('priority', 2);

    // 6. Nearest declaration: gr now holds sys_user, so "gr." below this line lists sys_user fields.
    gr = new GlideRecordSecure('sys_user');
    gr.addQuery('user_name', 'admin');

    // 7. Similar names: "subgr" must not change what "gr" resolves to.
    var subgr = new GlideRecord('cmn_location');
    subgr.addQuery('city', 'Sydney');

    // 8. Table names: clear the string below and type "sys_us"; rotation shards such as syslog0001 are hidden.
    var tableCheck = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');

    // 9. Script Include members: "utils." lists countActive, lookup, format, describe, double, half,
    //    getFieldValue, config and defaultTable — not retries, timeout, onError or onDone.
    var utils = new WEPlusTestUtils('global');

    // 10. Signature help: place the cursor after "'active'" on the second line of this call;
    //     the hint shows countActive with "field" highlighted.
    var activeCount = utils.countActive(gr.getTableName(),
        'active');

    // 11. Hover: hover countActive above; expect one block with its description, @param and @returns text.

    // 12. Parameters: hover lookup, format and describe. lookup's options type lists table, field and
    //     an optional limit; format ends with ...values: string[]; describe's second parameter is the
    //     optional param1 (a destructured object).
    var values = utils.lookup({ table: 'incident', field: 'number', limit: 5 });
    var line = utils.format('Values', values.join(', '));
    var description = utils.describe(gr, { verbose: true });

    // 13. Table and field arguments: clear the third argument below for incident fields;
    //     the first argument suggests table names.
    var number = utils.getFieldValue('incident', gr.getUniqueValue(), 'number');

    // 14. Static members: "WEPlusTestUtils." lists DEFAULT_LIMIT, FIELD_GROUPS and SEPARATOR.
    var limit = WEPlusTestUtils.DEFAULT_LIMIT;

    // 15. Constants-only Script Include: "WEPlusTestConstants." lists STATE_APPROVED, MAX_RETRIES and LABELS.
    var approved = WEPlusTestConstants.STATE_APPROVED;

    // 16. ES2021 class: "greeter." lists greet, count and name; "WEPlusTestES6." lists VERSION and create.
    var greeter = new WEPlusTestES6('Ada');
    var greeting = greeter.greet('?');
    var version = WEPlusTestES6.VERSION;

    // 17. Built-ins: typing "JSON." or "Math." sends no Script Include lookup (check the browser's Network tab).
    data.summary = JSON.stringify(
        {
            activeCount: activeCount,
            approved: approved,
            description: description,
            greeting: greeting,
            limit: limit,
            line: line,
            number: number,
            table: tableCheck.getTableName(),
            version: version,
        },
        null,
        2
    );

    // 23. Server response data: refreshedTotal is only read from the c.server.get response in the
    //     client script; it must not show a "never used" hint.
    if (input && input.action == 'refreshTotal') {
        data.refreshedTotal = activeCount;
    }
})();
</script><servicenow>false</servicenow><sys_class_name>sp_widget</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_created_on><sys_id>ffdf3417f457eaaeacf87aac54095ff6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_widget_ffdf3417f457eaaeacf87aac54095ff6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-01 07:25:13</sys_updated_on><template><div class="panel panel-default we-plus-test">
  <div class="panel-heading">
    <h3 class="panel-title">Widget Editor+ IntelliSense test bench</h3>
  </div>
  <div class="panel-body">
    <!-- 21. Attributes: inside a tag, type "ng-" for AngularJS directive suggestions. -->
    <!-- 22. Classes: inside class="", press Ctrl+Space for classes from the chosen portal theme. -->
    <p>Client total: {{c.total}}</p>
    <p ng-if="c.loading">Loading…</p>
    <pre ng-if="data.summary">{{data.summary}}</pre>
  </div>
</div>
</template></sp_widget></record_update>
